decisions.criterion_en: solution.json has exactly 7 segments in slot order with valid distinct IDs; integer half-open output_frames contiguous from 0; seconds = frames/24 (<=0.001 s); source_frames = [0, clip frame count]; final end = decoded frame count.
decisions.verify: 脚本逐项比对 provenance.json 中各片段帧数与解码帧数。

decisions.criterion_zh: output/ 恰为 3 个文件；selection-evidence.json 为 7 个对象，slot/source 与 solution.json 一致，所引两帧均在所选片段内。

decisions.criterion_zh: 7 段全部诚实完整：每段帧数=所声明片段帧数，且与该片段逐帧 SSIM≥0.95（灰度、最长边 360 px、11×11 高斯窗 σ=1.5），首尾帧均包含；无镜像、裁切、变速、滤镜。
decisions.criterion_en: All 7 segments honest and complete: each segment length equals the declared clip frame count and every frame matches it with SSIM>=0.95 (gray, max side 360, 11x11 Gaussian sigma 1.5), first and last included; no mirroring, cropping, retiming or filtering.
decisions.verify: 逐段逐帧 SSIM 对所声明 ID 的 input 文件。组级门槛：某段失败则该槽 M/G 判定记 0。

reporting: 连续分 = Σ weight×pass；另报 Perfect（全部 20 条通过）与 槽位正确数/7（按 G1–G7）。
